title: Time words order
explanation: In Chinese, time words (when) come BEFORE the verb, typically right after the subject. Order: Subject + Time + Place + Verb.

examples.pinyin: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng
examples.english: I am going to Beijing tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: tā zài gōng sī gōng zuò
wǒ men zuó tiān zài jiā chī fàn
tā měi tiān zǎo shang pǎo bù

notes: Time phrases like 明天, 昨天, 每天 go after the subject, before the place and verb. Never put time at the end of the sentence like in English.
